mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_slo_alert (tenant_id, policy_id, window_end_minute, alert_type, active_policy_id, status, short_burn_rate, long_burn_rate, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{policyId}, #{windowEndMinute}, #{alertType}, #{activePolicyId}, #{status}, #{shortBurnRate}, #{longBurnRate}, #{firstSeenAt}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_slo_alert WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND active_policy_id = #{policyId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKED') LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_slo_alert SET short_burn_rate = #{shortBurnRate}, long_burn_rate = #{longBurnRate}, last_seen_at = #{seenAt}, update_time = #{seenAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKED')

UPDATE ai_slo_alert SET status = 'RESOLVED', active_policy_id = NULL, short_burn_rate = #{shortBurnRate}, long_burn_rate = #{longBurnRate}, last_seen_at = #{resolvedAt}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, update_time = #{resolvedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'ACKED')
